name: Rousen'in Rise
source:
Rise is a 2nd year student in Final Course and granddaughter of the chairwoman of the school board. She’s also the leader of the reform party -- more precisely, she’s the only student in school in favor of reform at all. Leader of the White Lilies, she wants to become the student council president to reform the school to be coed. However, others don’t share this view and she is soon the only member of the White Lilies.

Her title, ”Soleil D’Ecole,” means ”Sun of the School” and it shows. The girls of Vincennes fell in love with her at first sight. But despite her transcendent popularity, many find her difficult to approach due to her rather progressive ideals... In some ways, she really is like the sun. 

When she meets [url=/c3103]Masaya[/url], she decides he’s the one she’s looking for and arranges his transfer. As she watches him, she decides she really does have good taste. 

”Listen to me. It’s up to you to get them to accept reform.”

[From [url=http://amaenboda.wordpress.com/2011/12/14/aero-game-review-princess-evangile/]Aero's review[/url] & [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=117]Mangagamer[/url]]
